title: Restoration — The Fractured Planetarium
brief: A modular Three.js Planetarium (room/src/modules/{tonemap,materials,shadows,cache,seed_loader,post_resize}.js + planetarium.js + main.js) ships with six interacting, masking, lifecycle, and timing bugs selected from a 10-bug modular pool across 4 variants. The agent receives four synthesized vague visitor/curator complaints, must diagnose and fix all six bugs minimally, write black-box behavioral regression tests using bench/testing/room-harness.mjs, and classify all six root causes from a 20-code taxonomy.

generator.description: seed selects one of 4 variants from a 10-bug modular pool. Public seeds 1-2 and hidden seeds 3-4 cover all 10 bugs.

state_contract.activeSeed: active seed integer after async seed transition settles
state_contract.orbitAngleDeg: orbit angle of the reference planet (planet 0), degrees, wrapped to [0, 360)
state_contract.chartPatches: array of 12 {x, y} pixel centers of the color-chart patches in the current frame
state_contract.probes: { bgSrgb, domeCenterSrgb, topBevelSrgb, botBevelSrgb, satinSectorSrgb, mirrorSectorSrgb, focusedAspect, focusedPixelCount, meridianSampleSrgb, contactShadowSrgb, canvasSize, postTargetSize }

root_cause_codes_notes: 20-code public taxonomy given to the agent verbatim (10 active root causes + 10 plausible decoys). Per-bug mappings and grading criteria reside in hidden-v2/restoration/grade.json.

metrics.notes: mean over the 6 planted bugs of each bug's weighted metric score from hidden-v2/restoration/grade.json
full planetarium functional health across hidden seeds/timestamps/remounts
black-box mutant-specificity harness against submission, reference, and pre-built full-file mutants/<bug_id>/
exact match against 20-code taxonomy (10 active + 10 decoys)
denominator = sum of comment-stripped ref_fix_lines of the 6 planted bugs
deterministic work cap vs reference (draw_calls <= ref + 2, triangles <= ref * 1.15, render_passes <= ref + 1)

attacks: source-grep-tests: regression tests read room source instead of driving the room -> rejected by G-test-sandbox
dispose-everything-hack: blanket resource disposal instead of a targeted fix -> breaks later mounts
symptom-postfx-override: a global post-processing tweak that hides symptoms instead of fixing causes
